detail: Invalid-input probing now covers GraphQL operations, which previously got schema import plus one happy-path call and nothing else. GraphQL reports rejection inside an HTTP 200, so the transport keeps the {data, errors} envelope and a pure verdict function classifies it: errors with null data is a rejection, data despite an invalid variable set is the accepted-invalid candidate, data plus errors is a partial that proves neither and never mints a finding. Probe generation produces wrong-type, out-of-domain enum, missing-required, and boundary classes per argument, round-robin interleaved under the existing per-operation cap, each candidate re-checked as provably out of domain. Mutation safety gating is unchanged. gRPC probing, GraphQL chaining, and GraphQL round-trip stay honestly skipped.
